# sonarqube_measures (Data Source)

Provides a Sonarqube Measures data source. Use this to read metric measures for a component.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_measures" "my_project" {
  component   = "my_project"
  metric_keys = ["coverage", "reliability_rating", "security_hotspots"]
}

output "coverage" {
  value = data.sonarqube_measures.my_project.measures
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component` (String) The key of the component (project) to retrieve measures for.
- `metric_keys` (List of String) List of metric keys to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `measures` (List of Map of String) List of measures returned by SonarQube.
